name: Blast Off!
summary: Blast Off! is an endless arcade climb for iPhone. Launch a rocket from the pad and fly as high as you can, steering by tilting the phone or dragging a finger. Touch anything and the flight is over. The climb runs from birds and hot-air balloons, past airliners and satellites, through meteor showers and an alien blockade into deep space, where asteroid belts, ion storms, black holes and alien armadas keep changing. Collect fuel orbs to keep the engine running, chain close calls for combos, fire a laser at rocks and alien fighters once in space, unlock 15 rockets and their paint jobs, and climb the Game Center distance leaderboard.
